title: Evaluating & Choosing LLMs — Run the Real Job as an Audition
key_insight: Build a small set of representative requests with expected qualities. Compare models on those cases before choosing one.
body:
## Run the Real Job as an Audition

A model tops a public leaderboard but fails the company’s support tone and product facts. The benchmark measured a different job.

Build a small set of representative requests with expected qualities. Compare models on those cases before choosing one.

Include cost, response time, privacy, and availability beside answer quality. A useful model must fit the whole application.
common_mistakes: The biggest model is automatically best for every product.
One public benchmark replaces task-specific testing.
A model-based grader is perfectly objective and never changes.
mini_exercise: Draw “Run the Real Job as an Audition” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Model families and versions change quickly, so a repeatable evaluation process is more durable than one recommendation.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Run the Real Job as an Audition,” explain Evaluating & Choosing LLMs without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
